description: Defines classes, structures, and constants for managing DPDK-based baseband device (bbdev) accelerators, including configuration, resource reservation, and device info retrieval.

classes.name: bbdev_acc
classes.description: Represents a DPDK-based baseband device accelerator, managing device info, queues, and resource reservation.

methods.name: bbdev_acc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bbdev_acc object with configuration, device info, and logger.

methods.name: get_socket_id
methods.description: Returns the socket ID used by the device.

methods.name: get_nof_ldpc_enc_cores
methods.description: Returns number of LDPC encoder cores.

methods.name: get_nof_ldpc_dec_cores
methods.description: Returns number of LDPC decoder cores.

methods.name: get_harq_buff_size_bytes
methods.description: Returns HARQ buffer size in bytes.

methods.name: get_msg_mbuf_size
methods.description: Returns size of mbuf for unencoded/unrate-matched messages.

methods.name: get_rm_mbuf_size
methods.description: Returns size of mbuf for encoded/rate-matched messages.

methods.name: get_nof_mbuf
methods.description: Returns number of mbufs in pool.

methods.name: reserve_queue
methods.description: Reserves a queue for a specific operation type.

methods.name: reserve_encoder
methods.description: Reserves an LDPC encoder instance, returns its ID.

methods.name: reserve_decoder
methods.description: Reserves an LDPC decoder instance, returns its ID.
